column_description: TEXT. Foreign key to the robot_record table (BotCode). PK, FK to robot_record.
TEXT. Manufacturer name of the robot. Possible values: ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Universal Robots, Yaskawa.
TEXT. Model series of the robot. Example: Series_784.
CHAR(15). Type of the robot (e.g., industrial, collaborative). Possible values: Articulated, Cartesian, Collaborative, Delta, SCARA.
REAL. Payload capacity of the robot in kilograms. Possible values: 3, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200.
BIGINT. Reach distance of the robot in millimeters. Example: 1592.
DATE. Installation date of the robot. Example: 10 Jun 2023.
TEXT. Firmware version of the robot. Example: 9.6.6.
TEXT. Control type of the robot (e.g., manual, automatic). Example: Controller_C2.
